description: DocumentMover collision and naming decisions. One workspace root holds `files` (relative path to content). `move` names the source (`from`), the destination folder (`toParent`, relative to the root, may be empty), an optional `preferredName` and an optional collision `choice` (cancel, keepBoth, replace). `approve` applies to replace: `existing` approves the revision the first call reported, `stale` approves a revision that no longer matches, omitted means no approval. Outcomes: `completed` (source is gone, destination holds the source bytes), `collision` (nothing changed; the caller must choose), `cancelled` (nothing changed), `rejected` (unsafe path; nothing changed). `files` in `expect` is the complete set of visible documents afterwards. `recovery` lists the contents preserved as recovery copies. Sidecar files (names starting `.clio-`) must not remain after a completed move. Scenarios marked platforms:['windows'] cover Windows-only name hardening.

scenarios.name: moving onto itself is a no-op
collision without a choice reports the collision
keep both picks the next free name
replace with an approved revision preserves the replaced bytes
replace without approval reports the collision
replace with a stale approval reports the collision
a path in the preferred name is reduced to a file name
a parent that climbs out of the root is rejected
windows case-only rename keeps one file
